interface.title: MatD3 materials database (HybriD3)
interface.field: Materials science: hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites, experimental and computed material properties
interface.stage_of_work: Curating, sharing and looking up published property data after experiments or calculations are done
interface.what_it_is_for: A web database where researchers sign in, add property datasets for a material system (with reference, property, unit, sample type, data points and attached files), search and compare existing datasets, and have other staff members verify them.

data.note: The built-in fixture holds one system (MAPbCl3) with one experimental band-gap dataset (ID 1, from testuser) and no data points. The run plan (plan.json, not the README) called it a 'pre-loaded dielectric-constant dataset', but it is actually this band-gap one. Lookup tables (properties: atomic structure, band gap, dielectric constant, phase transition temperature, pressure; units eV, Å, GPa, K; one reference '2000 - F. Last, journal 1') come from the fixture. I uploaded the test file dielectric_vs_temperature.txt into the Add Data data-points box, but that form could not be submitted. I then created a new dataset (ID 2) through the Django admin and attached the same file to it. The fixture has no plain temperature property, so 'phase transition temperature' (unit K) stood in as the secondary property. Dataset 2 has no data points, because Data subsets are read-only in the admin.

features.name: Mode-switching search form with direct ID jump
features.general: Choose which field to search on; the form swaps between a free-text box and a numeric min/max range with an origin filter. Or skip searching and jump straight to a record from an ID list.
features.specific: Search for Materials: the Search term list (Formula, Physical property, Organic/Inorganic Component, Author, Band gap, DOI) swaps in Band gap Min/Max (eV) plus Type (Any/Experimental/Computational). Results are a table of compounds linking to the material page. Below it are Material ID and Data set ID lists, each with its own Submit.
steps: Pick the search field in the Search term list
Type a term, or for Band gap enter Min and Max and pick Type
Press Submit to get a compound table (or 'No results found')
Click a compound to open its material page, or pick a Data set ID and press its Submit to open that dataset
serves_tasks: Find a material by its name or formula
Find materials that have a given measured property
Filter records by a value range and by experimental vs computed origin
Jump straight to a known record by its ID

features.name: Data-subset editor with text-file import
features.general: Enter a series of measured points as whitespace-separated columns, filled from a plain-text file. Repeat it per subset and add properties held constant within a subset.
features.specific: Add Data, Data panel: Number of subsets creates Subset #1..n cards. Each card has Crystal system radios, a Label, Add fixed property rows (Property, Unit, Fixed value, red x to remove) and a Data points textarea ('value_1 value_2 ...') with 'Import from file...'. There is also an 'Import all from file...' for every subset at once.
steps: Set Number of subsets (subset cards appear or disappear)
In a subset, press Import from file... and pick a .txt file; the textarea fills with the file text and Is figure is ticked
Where a property is held constant in a subset, press Add fixed property and fill Property, Unit and Fixed value (the red x removes a row)
Check the filled points before submitting. Nothing is checked on import: the '#' comment line, the outlier 312.4 and the one-column line '90.75' all went in unchanged
serves_tasks: Load raw measured points from a text file instead of typing them
Describe how the data is split and what is held fixed

features.name: Dataset card with figure/table toggle and file bundle download
features.general: Show one dataset as a card. It holds a chart of one property against another (switchable to a table), fold-out source and metadata panels, and a button that downloads the data with its attached files.
features.specific: Dataset page /materials/dataset/<id>: a chart area for the primary property vs the secondary property (x-axis label with unit) and the reference citation. Show table / Show figure toggles the view, and Reference/Meta/Notes '(click to expand)' panels sit below (they showed no content in this run). Download data returns files.zip. For the owner the card also has Unpublish, Edit (opens the admin change form) and Delete. Only empty axes were seen, because no dataset had data points.
steps: Open a dataset from the Data set ID list
Read the chart of primary vs secondary property
Press Show table to switch to the values table, and Show figure to switch back
Press Download data to get files.zip with the attached files
As owner, press Edit to revise the record, or Unpublish/Delete to withdraw it
serves_tasks: Look at a dataset's values as a property-vs-property chart or as a table
Download a dataset with its attached files
Revise or withdraw a dataset you contributed

features.name: Peer verification badge
features.general: Let a second trusted user confirm a record after a confirmation prompt. The record then shows a 'Verified' badge, and the confirmation can be withdrawn. The record's own creator cannot verify it.
features.specific: The Verify data button on a dataset card asks 'Have you verified the correctness of the data?'. Accepting adds a green Verified badge next to the property name and turns the button into Unverify. It is greyed out when the logged-in user created the dataset.
steps: Open a dataset submitted by someone else
Press Verify data
Accept the confirmation prompt
See the Verified badge and the Unverify button
serves_tasks: Mark another contributor's dataset as checked

features.name: Material page with its dataset cards
features.general: Open one material's page from search results and see the datasets recorded for it, each as a card with its own controls.
features.specific: /materials/<id> (reached from a Formula search result): the MAPbCl3 page lists its datasets as dataset cards, with Download data and Verify data. Only band-gap dataset 1 appeared; the admin-made dataset 2 did not show here (033).
steps: Search by formula and click the compound in the results table
Scroll the material page to the dataset cards
Use a card's controls (download, verify) or open the dataset
serves_tasks: Find a material by its name or formula
Download a dataset with its attached files

screens_never_reached: Add Data pickers for Select reference, Select system, Primary/Secondary property and units: only the labels appear, on both 127.0.0.1 and localhost (screens/010.webp, screens/031.webp). The fixed-property Property and Unit lists are empty too, though the admin shows the data exists (screens/030.webp). The review traces this to add_data.js requests that did not return in the sandbox, not to the app. Any inline 'add new reference/system/property/unit' controls tied to these pickers were therefore never seen.
Synthesis method / Experimental details / Computational details sections on Add Data: clicking '(click to add)' does not open them (screens/026.webp, screens/027.webp)
Reference / Meta / Notes panels on dataset cards: the label switches to 'click to hide' but no content appears (screens/006.webp)
Report an issue dialog: pressing the button shows nothing (screens/008.webp)
Search results in the site layout: formula and property searches return a bare, unstyled table page (screens/004.webp)
A chart with plotted points: dataset 2 was made in the admin, where Data subsets are read-only, so it has no data points and the chart and table are empty (screens/034.webp, screens/035.webp)
Dataset 2 on the MAPbCl3 material page: it shows only the band-gap dataset (screens/033.webp)
Mint DOI: not pressed, because it would publish a DOI through an outside service
Import data from a Qresp server: needs an outside Qresp URL, which this sandbox cannot load (screens/013.webp)
not_done: Submitting a dataset through Add Data: blocked because the required Reference, System and Property pickers never appear, so 'This field is required' errors come back (screens/011.webp, screens/029.webp). The dataset was created through the admin Data sets > Add form instead (screens/030.webp, screens/032.webp).

Origin of data / Sample type on Add Data: two clicks were made in that row after screens/028.webp, but no kept screen shows the result. The earlier claim 'chose Theoretical and Powder' is not supported; screens/028.webp shows Experimental and Single crystal selected.
Removing a fixed-property row with the red x: pressed once, but only as cleanup, not as a step of describing the data.

Saving the uploaded data points: the textarea filled from the file, but the form could not be submitted, so I never saw how the server handles the missing-second-column line or the 312.4 outlier. The client-side import accepts them without warning.
Viewing values as a chart to spot the outlier: no dataset with data points exists, and the admin cannot add subsets. As testuser, the dataset 2 page showed no chart at all (screens/037.webp).
Comparing values across studies: the fixture has one band-gap dataset and the admin-made dataset 2 did not appear on the material page, so no side-by-side comparison was possible.

Band-gap range search Type = Computational, and the Author, DOI, Organic and Inorganic Component searches: not tried because of the action budget. The experimental 0–10 eV search found nothing because dataset 1 has no values (screens/019.webp).

Unpublish and Delete on the dataset card, Unverify, Prefill from another data set (its OK button submits the whole form, screens/011.webp), Related data sets, Import all from file..., Profile Update, and Register: seen but not exercised to a result. In the replay, Register and Reset Password crashed on an SMTP error (no network).
Reading the contents of files.zip: the download is binary, so only its size was reported (314 bytes for dataset 1, 869 bytes for dataset 2 with the attached file)
Logging out by GET to /accounts/logout did not end the session; logging in as testuser replaced it
